_readme: Allowlist of private repos surfaced in Exhibit 4's 'Private Work' section. A repo shows up here — named, with commit COUNTS and DATES only, never commit messages, diffs, or content — only after being explicitly classified. New repos default to unlisted/excluded until reviewed; see privatewitness_scan.py --scan.

mystarch.note: Augment Intent chief-of-staff coordination workspace; private-forever by design, no public mirror. This path is a git worktree of the same repo Christopher originally pointed to (~/intent/workspaces/__chief__) — using the worktree checkout as the single canonical path to avoid double-registering the same history under two ids.

mystarch-acp-spoof.note: Test/spoof variant of the mystarch worktree, not distinct vocational work product. Left out rather than partially masked -- the registry's included/excluded model doesn't support a partial-redaction display name, and this looked like the safer default given the name itself.
